summary: Assign opening and disposal of shared persistence resources to one explicit owner, give dependent aggregates or services non-owning access, and drain already accepted asynchronous work before releasing the underlying resource.

title: Enforce semantic parity across interchangeable backends
summary: Define observable behavior at a storage-independent contract, implement that contract for each backend, and run shared conformance tests covering ordering, lifecycle, boundary conditions, and backend-specific corruption or repair behavior.

title: Evolve public contracts additively
summary: Introduce a new interface form by widening an existing contract rather than replacing it, preserve legacy inputs or outputs through aliases, defaults, or optional fields, adapt callers and parsers at the boundary, and test both legacy and enriched behavior.

title: Separate transient notices from durable results
summary: Carry interim or one-shot user notices outside the durable completion payload, route them through a channel appropriate to each surface, deduplicate or consume them according to their lifecycle, and preserve final results and control markers unchanged.

title: Separate actionable error copy from bounded diagnostics
summary: Normalize structured failure information, present concise recovery-oriented user copy, retain useful raw details in a separate bounded and redacted diagnostic channel, and exercise the actual catch and rendering paths to prevent missing, duplicated, or sensitive output.
